Dax 3.9.9

  • Dax’s browser now presents itself as the latest Chrome, so sites serve their full pages. Switch to Safari, Firefox, Edge or a phone browser from the D button’s User agent tab.
  • Closing a tab keeps you in the same folder: the next tab there, or the nearest folder above when it was the last one.
  • The sidebar starts narrower, holds the width you drag it to, and starts collapsed on screens of 14 inches or smaller.
  • Agent Watch and the Agent Monitor show each agent’s own logo.
  • Slow AI images, such as GPT Image 2 with a reference picture, no longer time out.
  • With Dax Companion 1.4: a bigger live Mac page on iPad, and a count on the phone’s Drawer of files you haven’t opened yet.
